footer.description: VonAI builds practical AI workflows for owner-led professional services firms. Based in Helsinki.

problem.title: Where firms like yours tend to get stuck
problem.pain1: Most of your people use ChatGPT or Copilot, but the way the firm actually works hasn't changed.
problem.pain2: New enquiries wait hours or days for a reply, because the people who could answer are busy with client work.
problem.pain3: Proposals and tenders take up evenings, and much of the text is rewritten from the last one.
problem.pain4: You'd like to automate something, but nobody has time to work out what, or to build it.
problem.closing: For a firm of your size, a good first step is a small one: take one repetitive job off your senior people's desks and measure what changes.

offer.title: Pick one workflow
offer.subtitle: Both are common in professional services firms, and both are easy to measure.
offer.option1Desc: Enquiries from your website, email or WhatsApp get a reply within minutes. Contact details go into your CRM and the client can book a meeting directly. Anything unusual is passed to a person.
offer.option1Metrics: What we measure: time to first reply, enquiries left unanswered, meetings booked.
offer.option2Desc: The system drafts a first version from the tender documents, your past proposals and your templates. Your expert edits and signs off. Nothing goes out without a person reading it.
offer.option2Metrics: What we measure: hours per proposal, turnaround time, proposals sent per month.
offer.otherNote: Have a different workflow in mind? Bring it to the call. If it repeats every week and the result can be measured, it may fit.

process.title: From kickoff to results
process.step1Desc: We go through the workflow with the people who do it today and record the baseline: how long it takes, how often it happens and where things slip.
process.step2Desc: We build the workflow, in your existing tools where possible. Your team tests it on real cases and we adjust.
process.step3Desc: The workflow goes into daily use. Your team gets a short walkthrough and written instructions.
process.step4Desc: After 30 days in daily use, a short report compares the same measures with the week 1 baseline. You see what changed and what didn't.
process.req1: One person in your firm who owns the workflow
process.req2: Access to the tools the workflow uses, such as email, CRM and document storage
process.req3: A few hours from the people who do the work today, spread over the four weeks

proof.title: Results from earlier work
proof.case1Problem: Enquiries arrived through WhatsApp, email and social media messages. The team was too small to reply quickly, and some leads went cold.
proof.case1Solution: We set up one system across WhatsApp, the website and email. It replies to new enquiries, saves contacts in the CRM, updates the deal and offers meeting times.

fit.title: Is this a good fit?
fit.good1: You run or co-own a firm of 10 to 100 people in architecture, engineering, consulting, coaching, law or accounting
fit.good2: You have a workflow that happens every week and costs real hours
fit.good3: Someone in the firm can own it after go-live
fit.badTitle: It's probably not for you if
fit.bad1: You're looking for an AI strategy document or a training programme
fit.bad2: The process you want to automate doesn't exist in a stable form yet
fit.bad3: You'd rather run several pilots at once

faq.title: Common questions
faq.a1: It depends on the workflow and how many systems it touches. The build is a fixed price agreed before we start, so the number doesn't change halfway. A monthly fee for monitoring, fixes and small improvements starts only after the day-60 results report. You'll get a quote after the free call.
faq.a2: Where possible, the ones you already have. We don't resell software. If a new tool is needed, it's set up in your firm's name and you pay for it directly. We'll explain the expected running costs before we start.
faq.q3: What about client data and confidentiality?
faq.a3: Your data stays in accounts your firm controls. We use AI services that keep data in the EU where possible and don't use it to train their models. We're happy to sign an NDA or a data processing agreement.
faq.a4: No. You decide what the system may do on its own and what a person checks first. In proposal work, an expert always reviews the draft before it goes out.
faq.q5: What if the results are weak?
faq.a5: Then the results report says so. We look at why and decide together whether to adjust the workflow or stop there. The monthly fee hasn't started yet, so there's no running fee for something that isn't working.
faq.a6: One workflow that runs and has been measured tells you more than a long plan. Once it's in use, it's much easier to see what the next one should be.
faq.q7: What happens on the free call?
faq.a7: We talk for 30 minutes. You describe the workflow that takes the most time, and we tell you whether it's a good candidate and what the 30 days would look like. If it isn't a fit, we'll say so.
faq.a8: Your firm does. It runs in accounts you own, so if you stop the monthly fee, it keeps working and stays yours.
